# Experimental all-backend storage preview

These local archives include the production-based rs.js source plus LWS,
OneDrive and Nextgraph, and the shared widget with AtomicServer discovery.
Each archive contains storage-preview.json with source and artifact hashes.
No npm publication or production deployment is implied. Real OneDrive, LWS
OpenID, Atomic consent and Nextgraph broker acceptance remain required.
OneDrive uses the public Ponder Source personal-account SPA registration;
this app origin must be registered before production sign-in can succeed.
Original upstream data modules, source links and licenses are retained.
